x: Moody, of the Police, won the 880 Yards, with Len Marchant beating the present Police Champion, R.

Les Cohen ran a good race in the 2 Miles, and Syd Jarlett and young Dave Main beat Moody, the Police Champion, in the 880 Yards. Eddie Pack also made a welcome reappearance, and we hope he will soon regain the form which took him into an A.A.A.
Putting the Shot (Seniors): 1 Moody (M.P.), 41 ft. 3 ins.; 2 Lewis (B.), 37 ft. 3 ins.; 3 Grigg (M.P.), 34 ft. 11 ins.; 4 Cook (W.M.T.); 6 Melchior, 31 ft. 1 in.
The 1 Mile saw Pettet and Moody of the Police in front, followed by Bill Lucas, now demobbed from the R.A.F., and Tom Morrell and Stan Eales filled the next two places.

Stan Botwright won the 440 and beat both Pettet and Moody, who were running for the Police in this event. Derrick Burfitt, on his home track, turned out for us in the 1 Mile and won easily in 4 min. 32.3 secs.
